# netbox_vpn_tunnel (Data Source)

Retrieves a single vpn tunnel from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vpn_tunnel" "example" {
  name = "site-a-to-site-b"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the vpn tunnel.

### Optional

- `encapsualation` (String) The encapsualation of the vpn tunnel.
- `status` (String) The status of the vpn tunnel.
- `tenant_id` (String) The ID of the tenant associated with the vpn tunnel.
- `tunnel_group_id` (String) The ID of the tunnel group associated with the vpn tunnel.
- `tunnel_id` (String) The ID of the tunnel associated with the vpn tunnel.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the vpn tunnel.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the vpn tunnel.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
